findings.title: Over-architected CRUD endpoint
findings.description: The implementation introduced three microservices and a message bus for a CRUD feature that fits in a single-file Express handler. The skill sw:architect advised 'always split persistence from transport into separate services', which led to inappropriate decomposition for a <100 req/min feature.

findings.title: Missing validation at boundary
findings.description: No Zod schema at the API boundary. The rubric criterion 'input-validation' failed with rationale 'sw:architect SKILL.md instructs to defer validation to domain layer'.
